name: Paper Locust Swarm
description: A book unfurls and its case forms into a leathery locust, its pages folding into an overwhelming swarm.
disable: DC 20 Thievery check to tear up the leather locust, or DC 18 Arcana check (trained) or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 22) to render the magic inert.
reset: The paper locust swarm resets after 1 minute if there are no creatures to target.
routine:
(1 action) The swarm moves up to 30 feet to share the nearest creature's space, slicing into them with their paper wings and spurs. The targeted creature must attempt a DC 21 Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 2d8+5 slashing damage.

Failure The creature takes 2d8 slashing damage and 1d6 persistent plus bleed damage.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is Clumsy 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fold Swarm
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the bookshelf

Effect The enchanted book transforms into a swarm of origami locusts and one leather locust. The trap then rolls initiative.
